Hair colour questions, answered

All hair colour, highlights and balayage services

  • Usually 12 to 16 weeks, because it grows out softly with no harsh line at the roots. A gloss or toner every six to eight weeks keeps the tone fresh.

  • It depends on the technique and on the length and thickness of your hair. We confirm the price after your free consultation and before we start, with no hidden charges.

  • Colouring and lightening can weaken hair. So we check your hair’s health first and offer Olaplex, a treatment that protects the bonds inside each strand, as an add-on to any colour.

  • Warm undertones glow with caramel, honey and copper, while cool undertones suit ash and mocha. Your colourist matches the shade to your skin tone during the consultation.
